essence: A city that can be told in two ways: as an exact inventory of towers, gates, canals, quarters, houses and chimneys from which its past, present and future could be calculated, or as the single morning that opened every road of a young camel driver's life.
textDetails: Marco offers two ways of describing Dorothea: an inventory of its facts, or the memory of the camel driver who guided him there.
Its walls carry four towers of aluminium, which flank seven gates.
Each gate has a drawbridge worked by springs, crossing the moat.
The moat feeds four green canals that run through the city, cutting it into nine quarters.
Every quarter holds 300 houses and 700 chimneys (derived totals: 2,700 houses, 6,300 chimneys).
Girls of marrying age in each quarter wed youths from other quarters.
Their families trade the goods each family holds as a monopoly: bergamot, sturgeon roe, astrolabes, amethysts.
Working from these data, one could compute anything about the city's past, present and future.
The camel driver came there in early youth, on a morning.
Crowds hurried along the streets to the market.
The women had beautiful teeth and met your gaze directly.
Three soldiers on a platform were playing ('clarino' in the Italian, 'trumpet' in Weaver's English).
Everywhere wheels turned and coloured banners waved in the wind (Italian 'scritte colorate': coloured lettering or inscribed signs).
Until then he had known only the desert and the caravan tracks.
That morning he felt that no good thing in life was beyond his hopes.
In later years he went back to gazing at the desert and its caravan routes, yet he knows that life was just one of the many roads that morning offered him.
visualConcept: A perfectly square walled city sits on an endless pale desert plain: a moat rings sandstone walls, two north-south and two east-west canals of vivid jade water cut the interior into a 3 x 3 grid of nine quarters, and four tall brushed-aluminium towers rise from the corners, mirroring the sky like scientific instruments. Seven gates carry drawbridges hinged on big visible coil springs, and every quarter is built to the exact census: 300 small cubic houses carrying 700 chimneys (100 houses with three, 200 with two), so a patient viewer could actually count them. The city exists in two states that are the two descriptions. In COUNT it is a surveyor's model in the blue minute before sunrise: desaturated and shadowless, fine white outline edges on every wall, a small floating tally over each quarter, and 36 faint ledger arcs joining every pair of quarters, along which beads of the four monopolies (yellow-green bergamot, black-pearl roe, brass astrolabe discs, violet amethyst) slide like an abacus computing the city's future. In REMEMBER the sun breaks the horizon and the same grid becomes the camel driver's morning: drawbridges drop with a springy bounce, crowds stream toward the market in the central quarter, three soldiers on a wooden platform raise their horns, waterwheels and windwheels spin, and banners painted with coloured lettering crack in the wind. Outside the walls many faint roads fan from the seven gates across the dunes like rays, and a single small caravan walks along just one of them. The idea reads at a glance: one plan, once as data that can be computed, once as a morning that cannot.
layout: Square plan, walls 30 units a side (x and z from -15 to 15), 2.2 high, 0.6 thick, sandstone; moat 1.6 wide outside the walls, water at y = -0.3, so the corners sit at radius ~23.5. Towers: four aluminium cylinders on the corners (positions interpretive; the text gives only counts), radius 0.9, height 10, slight taper, three ring bands and a short conical cap, metalness 1, roughness ~0.22, colour ~#cfd6de. Canals along x = -4.8, x = 4.8, z = -4.8 and z = 4.8, each 1.2 wide, passing under the walls through low water-arches into the moat, leaving nine quarters of about 9 x 9. Gates (interpretive distribution): two each on the north, east and south walls and one on the west (the caravan gate), each centred on a quarter's outer face; drawbridge planks 1.4 x 1.8 hinged at the wall with two helical springs (TubeGeometry on a helix) at the hinge. Houses: exactly 300 per quarter (2,700 total) in one InstancedMesh, in blocks of about 4 x 5 separated by 0.3 lanes, footprint 0.38-0.48, height 0.35-0.9, stucco tones; chimneys exactly 700 per quarter (6,300 total), 0.06 x 0.06 x 0.2. Each quarter keeps a 2 x 2 plaza with its goods stacked; the central quarter's plaza is the market (about 30 striped stalls) with a wooden platform 1.2 x 0.8 x 0.5 for the three soldiers. Two arched footbridges per canal segment (24 total). Desert plain to the fog horizon with gentle dune ripples; 21 dust roads (three per gate, splayed 20-40 degrees apart) run out to radius 60 and beyond, the caravan road entering at the west gate. REMEMBER adds ~900 instanced townsfolk 0.25 tall, 12 waterwheels (radius 0.45) on canal banks, 48 pinwheel windwheels (radius 0.25) on roof poles, and ~80 lettered banners and pennant strings in the series colours.
signatureMotion: 1) Census sweep (COUNT): a thin scan plane passes over the nine quarters in turn; in each, houses flash as they are tallied and a floating counter ticks up to 300 houses and 700 chimneys, while beads of bergamot, roe, astrolabe and amethyst glide along the 36 ledger arcs between quarters like an abacus computing past, present and future. 2) The morning arrives (switch to REMEMBER): the sun clears the eastern dunes in about 4 seconds, light warms from blue to gold, the seven drawbridges drop on their springs with an overshoot bounce, crowds pour toward the central market, the three soldiers lift their horns as faint sound rings ripple outward, wheels spin, lettered banners ripple on a vertex-shader wave, and a few women by the west gate pause and turn to face the camera. 3) Roads open: one after another the 21 roads glow faintly out into the desert as if every one were possible, while a single caravan of five camels and its driver plods along only one of them.
interactionDescription: Switches between Marco's two descriptions. COUNT is the inventory city: pre-dawn blue light, a high plan-like camera, outline edges, census tallies over each quarter and ledger arcs carrying the four monopolies between quarters, streets empty and still. REMEMBER is the camel driver's morning: the sun rises, the camera sinks to a traveller's height on the western caravan road, drawbridges drop, crowds, horns, turning wheels and lettered banners fill the city, and the roads fan out into the desert.
mood: Desert morning poised on the edge of sunrise. COUNT: the cool blue minute before the sun, dry clear air, no shadows, a precise, almost clinical stillness, colours desaturated toward slate and sand. REMEMBER: the first low gold from the east-north-east, long raking shadows, aluminium towers blazing like mirrors, dust motes and thin chimney smoke catching the light, a warm haze over the dunes and the felt noise of a crowd and brass even in silence.
caption: Dorothea can be told as arithmetic: four towers of aluminium, seven gates on springs, a moat feeding four canals of green water, nine quarters of three hundred roofs and seven hundred chimneys each, marriages crossing the canals while families trade bergamot, roe, astrolabes and amethysts, until every future can be computed. Or it can be told as one camel driver's young morning, when wheels turned, bright lettered banners cracked in the wind, and every road seemed to begin at its gates.
motto: Counted, a city tells its future; remembered, it gives you yours.
camera: COUNT (default): high plan-like view from the south-south-west, distance ~52, elevation ~60 degrees, narrow FOV (~32) for a near-orthographic map feel, target the central quarter at (0, 0, 0), north at the top of the frame, the whole square plus a margin of desert in view. REMEMBER: a 6 s eased glide to a traveller's view on the western caravan road, distance ~36, elevation ~16 degrees, target (0, 2, 0), looking east into the sunrise with the west gate and its drawbridge in the lower foreground and two corner towers flaring at the frame edges; slow autonomous drift of about 8 degrees either way.
